one_person.headline: Riff Quest is built by one person, in the open
one_person.body: No team, no investors, no growth targets. Support is what decides how much time goes into it and what gets built next.

one_off_ok.headline: A one-off coffee counts as much as a monthly one
one_off_ok.body: There is nothing to sign up for and nothing to cancel later. One coffee, once, is a completely normal way to support this.

v1.headline: Your amp has an off switch. Our Discord doesn't.
v1.body: Players talking gear, posting riffs and losing arguments about tone at every hour. Come say hi.

v2.headline: Practising alone is fine. Complaining alone isn't.
v2.body: Share your wins, ask about technique, find someone at your level to keep you honest.

v3.headline: There's a gear channel. It never sleeps.
v3.body: Pedals, strings, the guitar you definitely can't afford. Bring opinions.

v4.headline: Recorded a riff? Get real ears on it.
v4.body: Drop a clip and get feedback from players who know exactly how that bend feels.

v5.headline: Your guitar wants friends. You might too.
v5.body: Guilds, challenges and people practising the same thing you are. Join the Riff Quest Discord.
